newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Elite to negotiate European plants sale.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Elite to negotiate European plants sale.

text.p: Israel's Elite Industries Ltd said on Sunday it has decided to enter into negotiations with a European food company for the sale of its three coffee roasting factories in Spain, Belgium and France.
In a statement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange the company said the three factories are producers of private label coffee, which the company supplies to major chains.
Elite said it was first approached by the European company but did not give further details.
Elite is one of Israel's biggest food companies with 55 percent of its revenues derived from Europe. But the profitability of its European private label operations has been low.
The company has eight production sites in six countries in Europe in addition to seven sites in Israel.
Its European activity is divided into two activities: coffee and confectionery.
